titulo: The queue line of a channel with an on-screen source
hero_alt: A desk with monitors showing a transcript, a table of sources, and a vertical video being assembled.
lead: The finviral, saudeviral, and advviral radars automatically make one video a day about what the biggest creators in the niche have published, with the source of each number on screen. r7e and promoavatar make the reel and the videos for each audience. Before you build your own, look at the whole queue line and the role of each tool.
objetivo: explain the six stations of a channel's queue line with a source and choose which tool your channel starts with.

aprende.t: The six stations of the queue line
What each tool does: r7e, promoavatar, and the radars
Why the queue and the gate come before automation

secoes.titulo: A radar's queue line (finviral, saudeviral, advviral)
secoes.sub: The same engine in all three: only the channels, the rules, and the schedule change.

nos.detalhe: Lists the videos from the channels in canais.json (metadata only, through yt-dlp), downloads the audio, and transcribes it on your own computer with inemavox (Whisper large-v3). No paid API in this step.

itens.t: Who said it and the video

nos.detalhe: The agent reads the transcripts and notes each number or fact with who said it, the video id, the date, and the verbatim excerpt from the transcript. This is the only raw material the script can use.
claude -p, through the subscription and with no API, writes the lines and the visuals into roteiro.json and the approval text into legenda.txt, always working from the base.

itens.t: Is the excerpt in the transcript?
Failed twice: it does not go out

nos.detalhe: checar.py checks that each excerpt in the base is really in the transcript, that the numbers in the lines are spelled out, and that the niche notice and the CTA appear. If it fails, the script goes back once. If it fails again, the video is not made.

Nei's avatar comes from the HeyGen studio (subscription). If it fails, the version with a photo and a local voice goes out instead. The stage is a page rendered frame by frame, with counters, word-by-word captions, and the source on screen in every scene.

The video goes to the YouTube channel through yt-pubx and always to the bot on Telegram. The bot receives one of three things: the video, "no topic" (a weak day does not become a video), or "failed at X".

secoes.volta: Failed the check: the script goes back once
secoes.legenda: Without a queue and without a gate, automating social media just means posting the wrong thing faster. That is why this is step 4: it uses the terminal, the assistant, and the queue from the previous steps.

rolagem_fim.texto: Collection and transcription feed the base; the base limits the script; the check blocks anything without a source; the avatar and the stage assemble the video; publishing always notifies you. Each station is a lesson in this course.

secoes.sub: Tap each one. All of them are open INEMA repositories.

texto: You hand over one strong idea and out comes a 30-to-40-second 9:16 reel, in the 7-step trigger script, from the hook with a number to the request for a comment.
r7e (reel7etapas) gave the script; r7ex is the new standard (10/18/2026), with a TV-news finish. Lesson 2 of this course.

exemplo.texto: One thesis of the day → one reel with an avatar, panels timed to the speech, and "comenta PALAVRA" at the end.

texto: One topic becomes a script for each of 12 audiences (young people, 40+, entrepreneurs, educators…), each with its own trigger and its own channel.
The bot writes and stops: you approve before spending avatar and render. Lesson 6.

exemplo.texto: "/promoavatar <assunto>" → 12 scripts, 2 gates, 12 reels delivered to each audience's channel.

texto: The same topic yields three scripts for the same audience: reach (getting shared), authority (getting saved), and promotional (connecting pain to solution).
Recommended publishing order: reach → authority → promotional. Lesson 6.

exemplo.texto: "| alvos=jovens-alc,jovens-aut,jovens-pro" → three videos for young people, with different CTAs.

texto: They watch what the biggest names in the niche published, check every number against the transcript, and publish one short a day, with the source on screen and the niche disclaimer.
Finance, health, and law use the same engine; only the channel list, the rules, and the schedule change. Lessons 3, 4, 5, and 7.

exemplo.texto: Timer from Monday to Friday → a 40 to 60 s video with what they said yesterday and the day before, or "no topic".

secoes.sub: Copy it and fill it in before any automation. It guides the rest of the course.

  • saudeviral: health, the most-watched doctors, nutritionists, and psychologists, runs at 05:00, disclaimer "does not replace a medical consultation" and a NO CONSENSUS stamp.

The schedules are different so they don't compete for the GPU and HeyGen.

secoes.sub: r7e, promoavatar, and the viral channel for your niche, in under two minutes.
The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: A radar's script failed the check twice in a row. What happens?
opcoes: The agent swaps the numbers for rounded ones.
The video goes out anyway, with a warning.
The script keeps going back indefinitely until it passes.
The video is not made, and the bot receives the failure.
perguntas.explica: If it fails once, the script goes back for a fix. If it fails again, the video is not made. Better a day without a video than a number without a source.

perguntas.p: You want the same topic in three versions for the same audience: one to be shared, one to be saved, and one that leads to the course. Which tool?
perguntas.explica: promoavatar3 makes three videos per audience: reach, authority, and promotional. promoavatar makes one video for each of 12 audiences.

perguntas.p: What does the Telegram bot receive on a morning when the niche's channels published nothing relevant?
opcoes: A short video with whatever there is, even if weak.
Nothing: silence means there was no video.
perguntas.explica: The bot always receives one of three things: the video, "no topic", or "failed at X". A weak day doesn't become a video, and silence is never an answer.

perguntas.p: Why do finviral, saudeviral, and advviral run at different times (02:00, 05:00, and 08:00)?
opcoes: Because YouTube only accepts one upload per hour.
So they don't compete for the GPU and HeyGen on the same machine.
Because each audience wakes up at a different time.
perguntas.explica: All three use the same engine on the same machine. Separate schedules keep two of them from competing for the GPU and the avatar studio at the same time.
